chapters.label: Opening night
chapters.text: Paris, 2019, the Women's World Cup opener: France against South Korea. Just before half-time, Amel Majri swings in a corner from the left... Wendie Renard rises and powers it in!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Renard waits near the penalty spot. She jumps, meets the ball at the top of her leap, and heads it over her defender.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: the keeper doesn't move. Her second header of the night! France win four–nil.

chapters.label: Up, then down
chapters.text: The secret? Attack the ball at its highest point, then head it down towards goal.
